testing_gaps: The new running-worker cancellation branches in mcp/tasks.py:830-854 lack tool-level coverage: existing tests/test_mcp_tasks.py tool tests cover pending, terminal, and unknown tasks only. Add an owned running task whose cleanup is observable and verify cancellation waits for cleanup; also cover a running task absent from _live_tasks returning execution_not_owned without changing its persisted status.

Both new cancellation tests stop their fake worker by directly reading CARLTrainer._cancel_requested. Real TRL training instead stops when the registered callback sets control.should_training_stop, so these tests remain green if callback registration or its control update breaks. A callback-driven fake would cover the cancellation mechanism that prevents training from continuing after cancellation. Have the fake trainer invoke its registered on_step_end callback and terminate only when its returned control.should_training_stop becomes true; assert should_save too. Bound the thread and task waits so a broken callback fails instead of hanging the test process.
